Put passwords in DAG docstrings

pregunta: A healthcare provider (~50,000 events/s, region southeastasia) must: share a curated subset of columns/rows without granting base table access. Which option fits best? Constraint set #4.

opciones.texto_opcion: Create an authorized view (or authorized dataset) exposing only the allowed projection
opciones.explicacion: Authorized views let consumers query derived logic without direct table IAM.

opciones.texto_opcion: Clone full tables into every consumer project without filters
Grant dataEditor on all base tables
Export CSVs to a public Drive folder

pregunta: ensure client tools and connectors encrypt data in transit to BigQuery and Cloud SQL. Context: energy utility, sub-second interactive queries. Constraint set #4.

opciones.texto_opcion: Use HTTP without TLS to the API
Force sslmode=disable everywhere
Require TLS/SSL for connections and avoid plaintext JDBC/ODBC paths
opciones.explicacion: Encryption in transit is a baseline compliance control for managed data services.

opciones.texto_opcion: Mirror tables to unencrypted FTP nightly

pregunta: For a telecom operator workload with ~200 million rows/day: grant analysts read-only access to a single BigQuery dataset without project Owner. Best choice (variant 5)?

opciones.texto_opcion: Disable IAM and use anonymous dataset links
Share the service account JSON key in Slack
Grant roles/owner on the project to all analysts
Assign bigquery.dataViewer (and jobUser if needed) on the dataset, not roles/owner
opciones.explicacion: Dataset-scoped IAM least privilege is the standard BigQuery access pattern.

pregunta: For a payments fintech workload with near-real-time dashboards: encrypt BigQuery tables with customer-managed keys for regulatory key control. Best choice (variant 5)?

opciones.texto_opcion: Store plaintext copies in a public GCS bucket
Configure Cloud KMS CMEK on the BigQuery dataset/table encryption config
opciones.explicacion: CMEK lets the customer control key lifecycle while Google still encrypts data at rest.

opciones.texto_opcion: Disable encryption to simplify audits
Rely only on default Google-managed encryption with no CMEK option
opciones.explicacion: Does not meet CMEK control requirements.

pregunta: For a industrial IoT platform workload with ~5 TB/day: prevent data exfiltration from BigQuery and GCS to untrusted projects or the public internet. Best choice (variant 5)?

opciones.texto_opcion: Only open 0.0.0.0/0 firewall rules
Remove Cloud Armor alone as the full solution
opciones.explicacion: Cloud Armor is edge WAF, not data perimeter for BQ/GCS APIs.

opciones.texto_opcion: Publish all datasets as public Marketplace listings
Use VPC Service Controls with a service perimeter around sensitive projects
opciones.explicacion: VPC-SC constrains Google API access paths and reduces exfiltration risk.

pregunta: A healthcare provider (hourly batch windows, region brazilsouth) must: scan landing GCS files for PII before promoting to curated BigQuery tables. Which option fits best? Constraint set #5.

opciones.texto_opcion: Rename the bucket only
opciones.explicacion: Does not detect or protect PII content.

opciones.texto_opcion: Use Cloud DLP (Sensitive Data Protection) inspection/de-identification jobs
opciones.explicacion: DLP discovers and can redact/tokenize sensitive fields before wider access.

opciones.texto_opcion: Ignore PII and grant allUsers viewer
Use Cloud DNS private zones as the PII scanner
opciones.explicacion: DNS is not a data inspection service.

pregunta: Payments fintech scenario — keep EU customer data stored and processed only in EU regions for sovereignty. What should they implement? Constraint set #5.

opciones.texto_opcion: Use only Memorystore in any region without controls
Store everything in us-central1 regardless of policy
Replicate to public HTTP endpoints worldwide
Choose EU multi-region or specific EU regions for GCS/BigQuery and restrict job locations
opciones.explicacion: Location controls and job location policies enforce residency requirements.

pregunta: A payments fintech (hourly batch windows, region westeurope) must: block creation of public GCS buckets org-wide. Which option fits best? Constraint set #5.

opciones.texto_opcion: Disable Cloud Audit Logs
Enforce organization policy constraints denying public bucket ACLs/IAM
opciones.explicacion: Org policies provide centralized guardrails across projects.

opciones.texto_opcion: Ask each developer to remember not to go public
Make all buckets world-readable by default
